subject: FinTrust deployment path & isolation checkpoints
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fintrust.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: FinTrust call — deployment options & isolation gaps

Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum. Notes below from our discovery call with your infra and security teams.

Key requirements we heard
- Data residency: production data must remain in us-west-2; no cross-region replication without explicit sign-off.
- Strong tenant isolation: logical separation per customer, audit trail per tenant.
- KMS integration: customer-managed keys preferred, HSM support ideal.
- Audit logs: access to an immutable audit stream (S3 or syslog) with 12+ months retention.
- Egress controls: no plaintext PII leaving your VPC; outbound egress must be tightly controlled.

Qualification: Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) + VPC peering: our usual path for customers who want predictable throughput + network-level isolation via VPC peering or PrivateLink. Shared control plane but customer-managed VPC for data plane.
- Private (VPC or on-prem): private control plane option where we can run agent(s) in your VPC or provide an on-prem package for air-gapped environments. Higher operational lift but minimizes shared-surface.

Open questions for you
1) Do you require full physical separation (on-prem) or would a Dedicated cluster with VPC peering meet compliance?
2) What artifacts does procurement need to evaluate a Dedicated offering (SLA, certs, pricing cadence)?
3) Any additional restrictions on encrypted logs export or third-party processors?

Next steps we propose
- I attached a short isolation checklist (draft) — please review and mark items you need for procurement.
- Schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with your infra/security team (we have Wed/Thu next week open).
- If Dedicated looks right, we’ll produce a 6-month POC pricing / scope summary and list of required artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-isolation-checklist.pdf (draft), fintrust-network-topology.png (requested placeholder)

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0172

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@fintrust.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Dyer <marcus.dyer@fintrust.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: FinTrust call — deployment options & isolation gaps

Diego — thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from security/procurement: we are aiming to start with a cloud-first approach, so private on-prem install is lower priority for phase 1. That said, we have strict isolation needs that must be met before pilot kickoff: 

Clarifications / must-haves
- Preferred path: Dedicated capacity + customer VPC (peering/PrivateLink). We want to avoid multi-tenant compute for tokens and inference KV cache.
- Data flow: must ensure model prompts and generated outputs never traverse public internet in plaintext; TLS + VPC peering is expected.
- KMS: must integrate with our AWS KMS (CMKs). Can you confirm this is supported and how key rotations are handled?
- Audit logs: we need a push or export to our S3 bucket, with object-level immutability (S3 Object Lock) for 12 months.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent, pen-test summary, and list of sub-processors.

Procurement asks
- Draft SOW/POC SOW and pricing for a 6-month pilot (expected 10k-20k tokens/day, spikes up to 40k).
- List of items we must provide (network CIDRs, contact for networking, expected SLAs).

Can you send a simple network diagram that shows how Dedicated + VPC peering would look (minimal hops)? Marcus will coordinate procurement on our side once we have the artifacts.

On timing — Wed 10/14 or Thu 10/15 for the tech deep-dive works for our infra lead.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Security, FinTrust

Subject: Re: Recap: FinTrust call — deployment options & isolation gaps

Elena — great questions. Quick responses and a proposed checklist for the deep-dive.

1) Dedicated vs Private (short):
- Dedicated + VPC peering: we place inference nodes in our dedicated GPU pool that is logically reserved for FinTrust. Data plane sits in your VPC via peering/PrivateLink so customer traffic does not traverse the public internet. Control plane remains in Redwood-hosted control plane (we can offer a private control plane in enterprise plans if required).
- Private VPC/on-prem: we can deploy a private control plane and/or an on-prem package. This reduces shared-surface but increases ops overhead and lead time.

2) KMS / keys:
- We support AWS KMS CMKs for in-transit and at-rest encryption of customer artifacts. Customers can own CMKs; Redwood integrates via cross-account grants. Rotation is supported following AWS KMS best practices; we can document key rotation windows and responsibilities in the SOW.

3) Audit logs and data egress:
- Audit exports can be pushed to your S3 with object lock enabled, or streamed to your SIEM via syslog. We can sign a checklist item that audit objects are delivered to your bucket and retention configured on your side.
- Egress controls: we can restrict outbound network egress from inference nodes to only your VPC endpoints. No plaintext PII will be sent to third-party processors unless explicitly configured.

4) Network diagram and artifacts
- Attached: our suggested topology diagram for Dedicated + VPC peering (fintrust-network-topology.png) and a short isolation checklist (redwood-isolation-checklist.pdf).
- Required artifacts for procurement: SLA, SOC 2 Type II PDF, pen-test summary, sub-processor list, sample SOW. I linked a draft SOW in HubSpot and the design doc below.

5) Next actions
- Technical deep-dive: Wed 14 Oct, 10:00am PT — propose we confirm with Marcus/infra lead.
- We will circulate a 6-month POC pricing sheet (scope: 10k steady / 40k peak tokens/day) and a procurement artifact pack by EOD Thu (14 Oct).

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FT-4921

Thanks — Diego
